title: schlechterella aurantiaca
intro: Schlechterella aurantiaca, commonly known as the yellow milk bush, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Erythroxylaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Schlechterella aurantiaca include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-histamine, and anti-spasmodic agent, which may help in alleviating symptoms of allergies, anxiety, and muscle spasms.
